limits: Browser presentation uses a native rectangular view above the client renderer; HTML overlays cannot cover it.
Native presentation uses the actual pane bounds without CSS scaling. Chromium fits a model viewport inside those bounds; tool coordinates remain in page CSS pixels.
Background pages retain their native view in a hidden window for capture; no owned-guest embedding or cursor overlay is provided.
Navigation history records committed page events in private selected-source storage with literal substring matching; native Chromium history database semantics are unavailable.
Download history records stock DownloadItem observations in private scoped storage. Interrupted downloads are not silently restarted; model downloads retain their artifact and policy path.
Popups retain Electron's original child when supplied. Ordinary new-tab requests create a page in the same room with their referrer and POST data.
Requires the exact compiled and native-accepted owned Electron artifact and its retained engine receipt.
